description: This file contains unit tests for the ValidationEmployeeOtherEmailAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies the API's behavior for the 'getOne' endpoint and ensures that other methods correctly throw 'not implemented' exceptions. The tests are designed to validate employee email validation functionality in the HR management system.
